subject: Request for Pollination Contract
body_text:
Dear [Apiarist Sales Rep's Name], 

I hope this message finds you well! I’d like to confirm our pollination needs for Riverbend Family Orchards this season. We are looking for 50 hives to cover our almond segment, targeting the same blocks as last year. The expected delivery date is around February 15th, coinciding with the almond bloom. If possible, we’d also like to discuss a split delivery option to ensure maximum pollination efficiency. 

Please send over a clear contract reflecting these details at your earliest convenience. Thanks for your help!

Best,  
Michael McCarthy

subject: Inquiry About Pollination Services and Pricing
body_text:
Hi there,  

I hope this message finds you well! I’m reaching out to explore options for your pollination services, specifically for our almond orchard at St. Agnes Pollination. Could you provide some details on pricing and availability? We’re also considering the best time to schedule the pollination, so any insights there would be great. Looking forward to hearing from you soon!  

Best,  
Justin Torres

subject: Inquiry About Pollination Services
body_text:
